# Coin: a fat gold octagonal coin standing upright (the game spins it), origin at its centre. Up Z.
new
material new Gold --base-color 0.9647 0.8039 0.1490 --no-slot
material new Face --base-color 0.6745 0.4196 0.1490 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Coin --vertices 8 --radius 0.24 --depth 0.09 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Gold
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
inset 0.08
material assign Face
mode object
shade flat
export coin.glb
